threads.body: idk if you've seen all the code[ scanning alerts](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/security/code-scanning/264) related to having a toplevel `write` permission, but they'd prefer it be scoped to the job level (even though it seems silly since theres only 1 job)
threads.hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+name: Rerun failed daily jobs
+
+on:
+  workflow_run:
+    workflows:
+      - "Build (daily)"
+      - "Build (daily --no-build-cache)"
+      - "Daily GraalVM native tests"
+    types:
+      - completed
+
+concurrency:
+  group: rerun-failed-daily-jobs
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+permissions:
+  actions: write
